svg.title: News app: master architecture
svg.text: As of 2026-10-25 · flow: code → CI → registry → local deploy
① Your Mac — code (3 git repos)
Each service: own repo, own Dockerfile, own tests,
② GitHub — Actions CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, same in each service repo)
Trigger: every push (any branch) + manual "Run workflow" · ~1.5 min
needs: test → no image is pushed unless every test passed
permissions: read-only by default; only the image job may write packages
concurrency: a newer push cancels the older run on the same branch
(temporary "Show github context" step kept for the YAML learning session)
Public (no secrets inside; pull needs no token)
SHA tags never move → deploy & rollback by SHA
④ Your Mac — Docker Desktop: local deploy (news-app-platform/docker-compose.yml, project "news-app")
docker compose up -d · ~6 s redeploy · only the gateway publishes ports, and only on 127.0.0.1 (nothing reachable from your network)
reverse proxy · the only entry point
pg_dump per DB → backups/ folder outside volumes
restore into a fresh DB to prove the backup works
Secrets: dev default DB passwords locally; real ones only in an untracked .env on the machine that runs it — never in a repo or image.
Isolation: the gateway joins only "services"; each DB is on its own internal network with only its service + migrate job (no internet, not resolvable by others).
⑤ Inside each service — clean architecture
Also: YAML & GitHub Actions learning session (paused; resume at Part 2 exercises)
Also: skills for the best practices · trusted local TLS done (mkcert -install pending on this Mac)
Kafka needs ~1 GB more RAM (Docker Desktop limit locally, t4g.medium on AWS)
